Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Dry Cleaning Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Dry Cleaning Services provides professional dry cleaning and laundry services in a modern facility equipped with well-maintained machinery. Our operations primarily focus on customer drop-off and pickup, ensuring minimal on-site processing. We utilize environmentally friendly cleaning agents and adhere to strict safety protocols for chemical handling. Our team is trained in safety measures and equipment operation to mitigate risks associated with fire hazards and chemical exposure. We maintain comprehensive records of routine equipment maintenance and adhere to all local environmental regulations to ensure compliance and safety in our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2022, a malfunctioning heat press caused a small fire in the storage area, resulting in damages estimated at $3,000. The incident was contained quickly with no injuries reported. The fire department confirmed the cause and the incident is currently closed. On 09/10/2022, a customer claimed $2,000 in damages for clothing ruined due to an equipment failure. This claim is pending approval and investigation. Total reported losses to date are $5,000.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols during operating hours and a monitored alarm system.
